# Coterie

> A free, street-level vampire tabletop RPG built on the Powered by the Apocalypse (PbtA) framework, adapting Vampire: The Masquerade V5 into a fiction-first game of personal horror at middling crunch (medium rules complexity). Small coteries navigate the dusk-to-dawn hours: messy drama and consequences over centuries-spanning politics. Released free under CC0 1.0 and Dark Pack compliant: an unofficial, non-commercial fan project using Paradox Interactive's materials with permission. A free companion web app, Vamp, is in development: a native character sheet with a built-in dice roller.

Key facts:
- PbtA bones, VTM fangs: fiction-first Moves and Playbooks with Clans, Disciplines, Hunger, and Humanity
- Middling crunch: aims for medium rules complexity, snappier than VTM's dots and dice pools
- Five character stats: Blood, Shadow, Resolve, Demeanor, Wits
- Five coterie stats: Clout, Cohesion, Charm, Claim, Currency
- 22 Playbooks (14 Clan, 8 Clanless) and 17 Disciplines
- Basic Roll = 2d6 + stat; outcomes: 6- failure, 7–9 mixed success, 10+ success, 12+ critical (all 1s = Fanged Failure)
- Vamp character sheet app (in development, not yet publicly released): guided creation, built-in 3D dice roller, custom theming, and trackers
- 4–7 players, one of them the Storyteller
- Dark Pack compliant; full rules at https://coterie.zip, built with Zensical and hosted on GitHub Pages

## Core Systems

- [How to Play](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/how-to-play/): The fiction-first approach and how a session flows
- [Individual Stats](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/individual-stats/): The five character stats and what each governs
- [Rolling Dice](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/rolling-dice/): The dice mechanic and its outcome tiers (6-, 7-9, 10+)
- [Basic Moves](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/basic-moves/): The core moves every character can trigger
- [Harm & Healing](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/harm-healing/): Taking, tracking, and recovering from injury
- [Combat](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/combat/): Resolving violence within the Move framework
- [Debt](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/debt/): Favors owed and owing between characters
- [Clocks](https://coterie.zip/core-systems/clocks/): Segmented progress and threat trackers

## The Vampiric Condition

- [Kith & Kindred](https://coterie.zip/the-vampiric-condition/kith-kindred/): What vampires are in Coterie's world
- [Hunger](https://coterie.zip/the-vampiric-condition/hunger/): The Hunger track and feeding
- [Humanity](https://coterie.zip/the-vampiric-condition/humanity/): Holding onto (or losing) your humanity
- [Age Brackets](https://coterie.zip/the-vampiric-condition/age-brackets/): How a vampire's age shapes play
- [Blood Potency](https://coterie.zip/the-vampiric-condition/blood-potency/): The strength of the Blood and what it unlocks
- [Blood Potency Table](https://coterie.zip/the-vampiric-condition/blood-potency-table/): Reference table for Blood Potency effects
